newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nepal buys Aug diesel from Shell, BB Energy.
newsitem.headline: Nepal buys Aug diesel from Shell, BB Energy.

text.p: State-owned Nepal Oil Corp (NOC) bought by tender two cargoes of August delivery gas oil from Shell Singapore and Mediterranean trader BB Energy, an NOC source said on Thursday.

He said the first 30,000-tonne cargo of 0.5-percent sulphur gas oil for August 11-20 delivery, was awarded to Shell and the second cargo for August 21-31 delivery was awarded to BB Energy, both on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Madras and Haldia on the Indian east coast.
Traders said Shell's cargo was awarded at $162.69 per tonne, while BB Energy's cargo was awarded at $163.44 per tonne.
The NOC source said that it would issue another tender in a month's time to buy gas oil for delivery in September.
In its last tender for June 1-10 delivery, Nepal bought 30,000 tonnes of gas oil from Shell Singapore at $185.73 per tonne, c-and-f Indian east coast.
